bio: A beetle larva made of rivets. It is very small and very hard and it is saving up.
Its horns are I-beams. It builds bridges with its jaws and charges for the crossing.
A giant beetle carrying a library on its back for every town it stomps through. The towns are grateful and a little flattened.
note: Owns the bridge and the river under it.
Gives away the money with its name on the door.
